# Checkmate samurai

This local 24-pose transparent WebP is the approved miniature samurai from the October 17, 2026 preview. It was generated with the built-in image generator, using the approved black-armored, red-laced, two-handed samurai as reference. The sequence contains eight complete poses per upward, downward, and horizontal strike. The production renderer preserves the accepted timing, scale, and separated losing king at canvas coordinate (304, 101).

The renderer separates the connected alpha silhouettes once and caches them for both game and analysis views, preventing neighboring sword tips from entering another pose.
